text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage, including fatal overdosage, has been reported in patients taking NINLARO. Manifestations of overdosage include adverse reactions reported at the recommended dosage [see Dosage and Administration (2.1) , Adverse Reactions (6.1) ] . Serious adverse reactions reported with overdosage include severe nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, aspiration pneumonia, multiple organ failure and death. In the event of an overdosage, monitor for adverse reactions and provide appropriate supportive care. NINLARO is not dialyzable.
